title: UNREAL UPDATE! | Copi Cafe 67 | Cornucopias
description:
In this episode Co-CEOs  Rob Greig and Josh Jones have a bit of fun and we get to see the jokester side of them both.

They start off with the beverage choice and quickly move into  Launcher and Game Updates! Next they explain the benefits and timing of our planned Unreal Engine 5.3 upgrade.

@scruffylive365  ​ joins the guys to discuss plans for streaming at NFTxLV. Afterward we get some Community Questions answered, and finish up with an incredible Leak!

00:00 Beverage Choices
03:54 Launcher Updates
09:06 Game Updates
11:11 Unreal Engine 5.3
17:44 Special Guest Scruffy 
19:30 NFTxLV
29:25 Community Questions 
32:51 Leak!

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items. 

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/cornucopiasgame
